title: Strait of Hormuz impaired, not closed: strikes and vessel damage reduce traffic despite ongoing transits
summary: CENTCOM and IMO-confirmed incidents point to active maritime disruption in July, while conflicting Iranian and U.S. claims persist and traffic remains lower—not shut—according to reported shipping patterns.
